title: Cell dry mass over the cell cycle (per generation)
interpretation: Sawtooth growth-and-division across the multiseed/multigen ensemble (variant 0). Gen-1 cells (blue) grow ~390->680 fg and divide at ~42 min; gen-2 cells (orange) show repeated mass-halving division events. Confirms exponential single-cell growth with division near a doubling of mass.
command: v2ecoli native analyses (v2ecoli/workflow/analyses/) over .pbg/runs/showcase2-baseline/sweep/showcase2_baseline parquet; rendered to PNG via vl_convert/matplotlib on the mac mini
